text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I was sent a celestial globe... You are the
sender.
This is "Why"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a present from me! Uni...
Happy
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well... you often speak to the stars,
don't you? So
I thought, you must like
space!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... Yes. When doing
Exchange, "Fun" is
created.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So you do! That's such a poetic way to
enjoy
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, well... I tried emulating you, but I
feel like
how you do it is quite
different...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
During Exchange, one must adjust for
Parallax. It
is "Difficulty," yes?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, it's very difficult! That's why I'd
like to try
looking at the globe together,
if that's all right
with you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to be able to see the world as
you
experience it! ...That's why I decided
on a
celestial globe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Neo Universe reporting desire to

Observation with Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we can Share at least somewhat... I will
become
"Happiness."
